annotations.title: Read how much of its size a server used with players online

description: Returns the time the server spent with at least one player online in its latest unbroken run on its current size (its last 7 days with players, or more days back until they hold 8 hours), histograms of CPU, tick load, GC pause share, memory peak, the JVM's live set and memory outside its heap over that time, and suggestion: the smaller, cheaper size that would carry the same play, or null when the current size is needed or the evidence is too thin: at least 3 hours of play with a clear margin, or 8 hours otherwise. Use suggestion to answer whether the server can run on a smaller size; changing size is updateServer with the target size and applies on the next start.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
